name: Anne-Marie Kermarrec
one_sentence_summary: Anne-Marie Kermarrec leads the SACS lab at EPFL, researching large-scale distributed systems with a focus on decentralized/federated machine learning, scalable LLM and MoE inference, agentic AI, privacy-preserving vector search, and now fully decentralized RAG.
matrix_summary: The SACS lab released **ZeroRAG** (arXiv Nov 2026), a fully decentralised RAG system that routes queries semantically across up to 100k peers with no central coordinator — a notable step beyond the earlier RAGRoute work. Several other new preprints also appeared (AgentWeave, backdoor mitigation in decentralised LLM fine-tuning, robust fairness auditing, a provocative "End of Consensus Research?" position paper) alongside three new GitHub repos including one in Lean for formal verification.
